messages:
sophia: Quick sync about autofallback UX. Current problem: we alert on every fallback and the noise drowns out actual incidents for busy routes. Thoughts on a tiered approach?
kai: Tiered makes sense. Something like: 1) silent sample + audit, 2) digest to oncall, 3) pager if widespread.
ben: Agree. We should also differentiate degrade modes: graceful-degrade (soft quality loss) vs hard-degrade (model change due to OOM). Different thresholds.
sophia: Good point. UX needs to show the degrade type on the rollout row. Iconography: shield for graceful, siren for hard. Tooltip with the trigger metric.
ops-bot: note: any change to paging requires playbook update and a 2-week staged rollout per policy.
aurora: For audit payloads, proposal: keep a compact "decision_event" record: fields: evt_id, ts, route, degrade_type, trigger_metric, decision_notes, sample_sig, sample_excerpt_redacted, retention_days. We must avoid full prompts.
kai: Also add a small humanized reason and a machine code. UI will show human string but filters use machine code.
ben: Telemetry: emit fallback_events_total, fallback_routes_affected_5m, fallback_pager_count. Dashboards can show when digest suppressed pages.
sophia: Paging logic suggestion: page when fallback_routes_affected_5m >= 3 AND fallback_events_total_1m >= 8 OR when hard-degrade detected for a route with p99 latency spike. Otherwise digest.
aurora: Sanitizer: run PII detection and replace excerpt with "[redacted]" if necessary. Keep a prompt_signature (sha256) for grouping but no reversible data.
kai: UI: audit card should show timeline + short redacted sample + link to rollout. Also an affordance to "replay" with synthetic prompt (admin only) for debugging. That replay must be gated.
ben: Ops ask: include a counter of how many digests suppressed a page in last 24h so SRE knows if digest hiding problems.
sophia: Action items: aurora -> spec for decision_event JSON + retention; kai -> console mock with degrade icons and replay flow; ben -> dashboard panels + metrics; ops-bot -> draft playbook update. Back for sign-off next Fri. :thumbsup:
